# Freedom Clips AI

Freedom Clips AI is an open-source Python toolkit for turning long videos plus SRT transcripts into vertical short-form video clips.

Canonical capabilities:
- Continuous OpusClip-like clipping: ai_opusclip.py
- Dub-to-video timing alignment (drift-free): dub_align_video.py / freedom_clips/dub_align.py
- Multi-segment original-footage montage clipping: ai_viral_montage_clips.py
- Topic-agnostic and language-agnostic prompt defaults
- OpenAI Responses API for clip planning
- Strict JSON Schema plan output
- Local ffmpeg/ffprobe video rendering
- Pillow PNG text overlays
- 1080x1920 output
- LLM plan caching
- Plan-only and render-only workflows
- JSON, CSV and SRT sidecar outputs
- No generated-art API calls in the montage pipeline

Primary inputs:
- source video file
- primary .srt transcript
- optional secondary .srt in continuous mode

Primary outputs:
- final_clip_plan.json or final_montage_plan.json
- rendered vertical .mp4 files
- metadata.json per clip
- clip.srt per clip

Important invariants:
- render-only mode does not require an OpenAI API call
- montage speed changes must modify video PTS and audio tempo together
- prompt defaults must not assume a specific topic, ideology, language, or region
- montage plans use original source footage only

Architecture:
- freedom_clips/srt.py: subtitle parsing and timing
- freedom_clips/validation.py: clip validation
- freedom_clips/llm.py: OpenAI structured-output calls
- freedom_clips/plan_cache.py: cache
- freedom_clips/text_overlay.py: local hook/overlay rendering
- freedom_clips/ffmpeg.py: final video rendering
- freedom_clips/prompts/: LLM prompt builders and schemas

Best entry point for users: README.md
Best entry point for coding agents: AGENTS.md
Design specification: docs/CODE_REVIEW_SPEC.md
